content.short: Vaults that pay stablecoin yield from institutional real-world assets like credit and treasuries.
content.description: Nest takes stablecoin deposits and issues vault tokens whose price rises as the vault earns from real-world assets sourced from established financial institutions. Holders can redeem back to stablecoins instantly or on a schedule depending on the vault, and each vault's assets and liabilities are visible on-chain. The current app runs on Arc, and its Nest Savings mini app is available in World App.
content.meta: Deposit stablecoins into Nest's RWA vaults to earn institutional yield, with on-chain transparency and a World App mini app.
